- Use an OrderedDict that maps key -> (value, expiry), where expiry is None if ttl is None.

Safest approach: iterate and delete all expired ones.
- __contains__: check existence and not expired, don't change recency order.

Eviction: "Expired entries are deleted first, then evict least-recently-used entries in order until at most capacity remain." each value is stored as ``(value, expires_at)`` where\n    ``expires_at`` is None when the cache has no TTL.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be >= 1, got %r\" % (capacity,))\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        self._entries = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at)\n\n    def _expired(self, expires_at):\n        return expires_at is not None and self.clock() >= expires_at\n\n    def _purge_expired(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return\n        now = self.clock()\n        expired = [k for k, (_, exp) in self._entries.items()\n                   if exp is not None and now >= exp]\n        for k in expired:\n            del self._entries[k]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        entry = self._entries.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return default\n        value, expires_at = entry\n        if self._expired(expires_at):\n            del self._entries[key]\n            return default\n        self._entries.move_to_end(key)\n        return value\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        self._purge_expired()\n        expires_at = None if self.ttl is None else self.clock() + self.ttl\n        self._entries[key] = (value, expires_at)\n        self._entries.move_to_end(key)\n        while len(self._entries) > self.capacity:\n            self._entries.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        self._purge_expired()\n        return len(self._entries)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._entries.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        if self._expired(entry[1]):\n            del self._entries[key]\n            return False\n        return True\n"}"]]}

def parse_line(line, sep=","):
    fields = []
    cur = ""
    quoted = False
    i = 0
    n = len(line)
    while i < n:
